description: This file implements the cache tree data structure and associated operations for managing hierarchical index information in a Git repository. Functions include creating, freeing, updating, validating, serializing, deserializing, and verifying cache trees, as well as handling subtrees and integrity checks.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree * cache_tree(void)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new cache_tree structure with default parameters.

methods.name: void cache_tree_free(struct cache_tree ** it_p)
methods.description: Recursively frees a cache_tree and its subtrees.

methods.name: int cache_tree_subtree_pos(struct cache_tree * it,const char * path,int pathlen)
methods.description: Performs binary search to find the position of a subtree by path.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree_sub * find_subtree(struct cache_tree * it,const char * path,int pathlen,int create)
methods.description: Finds or creates a subtree node for a given path component.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree_sub * cache_tree_sub(struct cache_tree * it,const char * path)
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a subtree node for a specific path.

methods.name: int do_invalidate_path(struct cache_tree * it,const char * path)
methods.description: Recursively invalidates a cache_tree path, freeing related subtrees.

methods.name: void cache_tree_invalidate_path(struct index_state * istate,const char * path)
methods.description: Wrapper to invalidate a cache_tree path and mark cache as changed.

methods.name: int verify_cache(struct index_state * istate,int flags)
methods.description: Verifies the consistency and validity of the cache tree.

methods.name: void discard_unused_subtrees(struct cache_tree * it)
methods.description: Removes unused subtrees from a cache_tree.

methods.name: int cache_tree_fully_valid(struct cache_tree * it)
methods.description: Checks if the cache_tree and all subtrees are valid and complete.

methods.name: int must_check_existence(const struct cache_entry * ce)
methods.description: Determines if the existence of a cache entry must be verified, considering promisor remotes.

methods.name: int update_one(struct cache_tree * it,struct cache_entry ** cache,int entries,const char * base,int baselen,int * skip_count,int flags)
methods.description: Recursively updates a cache_tree from cache entries; generates tree objects.

methods.name: int cache_tree_update(struct index_state * istate,int flags)
methods.description: Updates the entire cache_tree for an index state.

methods.name: void write_one(struct strbuf * buffer,struct cache_tree * it,const char * path,int pathlen)
methods.description: Serializes a cache_tree into a buffer format.

methods.name: void cache_tree_write(struct strbuf * sb,struct cache_tree * root)
methods.description: Serializes the entire cache_tree starting from root.

methods.name: int parse_int(const char ** ptr,unsigned long * len_p,int * out)
methods.description: Parses an integer from buffer in textual cache-tree format.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree * read_one(const char ** buffer,unsigned long * size_p)
methods.description: Deserializes a cache_tree node from buffer.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree * cache_tree_read(const char * buffer,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Loads a cache_tree from a buffer.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree * cache_tree_find(struct cache_tree * it,const char * path)
methods.description: Finds a subtree within a cache_tree based on path.

methods.name: int write_index_as_tree_internal(struct object_id * oid,struct index_state * index_state,int cache_tree_valid,int flags,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Generates a tree object from index state, optionally for a specific prefix.

methods.name: struct:tree * write_in_core_index_as_tree(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Creates a tree object representing in-memory index state.

methods.name: int write_index_as_tree(struct object_id * oid,struct index_state * index_state,const char * index_path,int flags,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Wrapper to write index as a tree object to storage.

methods.name: void prime_cache_tree_sparse_dir(struct cache_tree * it,struct tree * tree)
methods.description: Initializes a cache_tree node as a sparse directory.

methods.name: void prime_cache_tree_rec(struct repository * r,struct cache_tree * it,struct tree * tree,struct strbuf * tree_path)
methods.description: Recursively builds a cache_tree from a repository tree object.

methods.name: void prime_cache_tree(struct repository * r,struct index_state * istate,struct tree * tree)
methods.description: Builds a cache_tree based on a on-disk tree object.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree * find_cache_tree_from_traversal(struct cache_tree * root,struct traverse_info * info)
methods.description: Finds cache_tree based on traversal info without reconstructing full path.

methods.name: int cache_tree_matches_traversal(struct cache_tree * root,struct name_entry * ent,struct traverse_info * info)
methods.description: Checks if cache_tree matches traversal info and index entry.

methods.name: int verify_one_sparse(struct index_state * istate,struct strbuf * path,int pos)
methods.description: Verifies a sparse directory boundary in the index.

methods.name: int verify_one(struct repository * r,struct index_state * istate,struct cache_tree * it,struct strbuf * path)
methods.description: Recursively verifies cache_tree integrity against index entries.

methods.name: int cache_tree_verify(struct repository * r,struct index_state * istate)
methods.description: Verifies the entire cache_tree in the index state for consistency.

methods.name: int subtree_name_cmp(const char * one,int onelen,const char * two,int twolen)
methods.description: unavailable
